variants.headline: Looking back: people leave the colony on the ship
variants.sub: The ship has taken away young adults with no work and families with no home.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: People have left the colony on the ship: young adults without work and families without homes.

A ship can carry people away as well as bring them here. Young adults with no work. Families with no home. Those plain circumstances deserve more attention than a fine speech about staying. Readers should ask what belonging requires before blaming someone for deciding to leave the colony.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We support {target} against indiscriminate blame. The departures and their circumstances are serious, but they do not establish every accusation about responsibility or prove that a supposed alternative would have kept people here.
